UKHC010130572026
WPSS No.1977 of 2026
Balwant Singh Rawat …………Petitioner
 Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and others ……….Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Anil K. Dabral, learned Addl. C.S.C. for the State.
3. The petitioner is a retired government servant of the 
Education Department who retired on attaining the age of 
superannuation on 31.08.2008 from the post of Assistant 
Teacher (L.T. Grade) and is presently 78 years old.
4. By means of the present, the petitioner is claiming the 
benefit of one increment on his pay w.e.f., 01.01.2006 and 
accordingly to refix his pension.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the 
matter of the petitioner has already been referred by Director, 
Secondary Education to Chief Education Officer, Dehradun 
along with as many as 23 other proposals vide order dated 
08.05.2026, but the said matter is still undecided.
6. Learned counsel for the State shall get clear instructions 
in the matter as to what action has been taken on the 
aforesaid proposal dated 08.05.2026 regarding the petitioner 
who name was found at Serial No.18 of the aforesaid letter.
7. List this case on 11.08.2026 as fresh.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 27.07.2026
SK

 Versus

Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Anil Dabral, learned Additional C.S.C. for 
the State.
3. Instructions were called for from the State. 
Today, instructions have been produced before this 
Court and are returned to the learned Additional 
C.S.C. for the State. On instructions, it is contended 
by learned Additional C.S.C. that grievance of the 
petitioner has already been redressed.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner disputes the 
statement made by learned Additional C.S.C. on 
behalf of the respondent.
5. In such view of the matter, four weeks’ time is 
granted to the respondents to file counter affidavit.
6. Thereafter, two weeks’ time is granted to the 
petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit.
7. List on 13.10.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
14.08.2026 AK
